g.text: Later refinements found small gains, but no new adoption

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6c76

g.text: Width 256 RoPE MLA · 1,200 updates · nine completed follow-ups, shown in research order

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5f6c76

g.text: Attention scale, EMA half-life and LayerNorm improved all three seeds, but missed the predeclared minimum gain. No effects are added together.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5f6c76

g.text: Whiskers use 4,096-token blocks; adoption also required every seed and all simultaneous text bounds to improve. Intervals are not holdout confidence.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #5f6c76

g.text: Equal per-arm LR searches where applicable; EMA uses the same online trajectory, and decay uses fixed common LR 0.00125. Sources: nine final quality reviews.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #5f6c76
